links.outcome: Bone age error of four multimodal LLMs versus an experienced radiologist reference standard
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 MAE 1.46 years, ICC 0.849; Gemini 2.5 Pro MAE 2.24; Grok-3 MAE 3.14; Claude 4 Sonnet MAE 4.29 years. Only ChatGPT-5 deemed clinically useful.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 demonstrated statistically superior performance with MAE of 1.46 years and ICC of 0.849, showing highest alignment with the reference standard.

unlisted_practices: Atlas-assisted prompting (providing a reference atlas to multimodal LLMs) for bone age estimation

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of four off-the-shelf multimodal LLMs on a retrospective pediatric bone age radiographic dataset using atlas-assisted prompting, without testing deployment practices or workflows.
